### Darkmoon Arcade 1.4.2

#### New option
- **Games on corpse runs:** a new option under Flights opens the arcade when you release your spirit – with the game chosen for flights – and closes it again once you are resurrected. A window you already had open stays as it is. Off by default. Many thanks to not_buneary on CurseForge for the idea!

Ideas, wishes or bugs? Let us know on CurseForge or GitHub.
